NONE: › relating to the process by which the amount of water in living things and the substances it contains are controlled

U: › specialized biology the process in plants and animals by which a liquid moves gradually from one part of the body or the plant to another through a membrane (= cell covering)
› the way in which ideas and information gradually spread between people

example: Fluid flows back into the tiny blood vessels by osmosis.
液體藉由滲透作用流回毛細管。
The children were never taught the songs, they just listened to other children singing them and learned them by osmosis.
從來沒人教孩子們唱過這些歌曲，他們只是聽別的孩子唱，慢慢就學會了。
Reading is not picked up by a process of osmosis, but needs to be taught.
閱讀不是在潛移默化的過程中學會的，而是需要教授的。

NONE: › the amount of pressure needed to stop the flow of a liquid through a membrane (= cell covering)
滲透壓（阻止水溶液穿透細胞膜的壓力）
